newsitem.title: GERMANY: MAN shares slip after says could cut div.
newsitem.headline: MAN shares slip after says could cut div.

text.p: Shares in German trucks and machinery maker MAN AG slipped on Tuesday after the group said it might cut its dividend payout for the 1996/97 business year ending June 30 if profits were poor.
MAN shares were down five marks at 368 marks, falling off a day's high of 379 marks.
The broader German share market was firmer, with the 30-share DAX index up over one percent at 2,888.14 points.
MAN paid a dividend in the 1995/96 business year of 12 marks, up from 9.50 marks in the prior yearly period.
But MAN said earlier on Tuesday that it still expected good results for the current year, particularly if the economy kept expanding.
